messages:
sam: quick sync for Acme Azure listing onboarding. partner asks for private-offer trial + clear conversion path. can we confirm what we need from them?

violet: ops checklist: publisher tenant id, offer alias, plan ids, manifest URL (we prefer container image URI), support email, and a webhook endpoint for consumption notifications.

harry: product note: trial should be 30 days, 50k token cap, no auto-charge. conversion manual via partner portal. add a note about usage caps visible in the offer.

legal-team: need explicit trial language, privacy disclosure (we only collect usage metadata, not user prompts), termination rights, and export control clause. will drop a template paragraph.

marketplace-bot: templates: https://internal.re/marketplace/templates/azure/private-offer.txt and manifest example at s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/templates/manifest-example.json

sam: paste a minimal manifest snippet we can send to the partner?

violet: minimal manifest (partner copy):
```json
{"offerAlias":"acme-redwood-try","plans":[{"id":"trial30","displayName":"30 Day Trial","eligibility":"private","usageCap":"50000"}],"supportContact":"partners@redwood.ai","manifestVersion":"1"}
```

harry: telemetry: route Azure marketplace consumption events to https://hooks.internal/re/marketplace/azure/consume-stub for now. include signature header X-Marketplace-Signature. ops to implement validation.

legal-team: user-facing trial blurb draft: "Start a 30-day free trial of Redwood Inference with up to 50,000 tokens per month. By enrolling you accept Redwood's marketplace terms and privacy policy. Trial may be suspended for policy violations."

sam: action items: violet=upload manifest to s3 and create offer alias in portal; harry=confirm trial plan limits in listing copy; legal-team=finalize text and EULA delta by tomorrow noon. I'll schedule partner handoff 10am PT.

violet: uploaded manifest to s3://redwood-marketplace/azure/acme/manifest-v1.json and created offer alias, waiting on OfferId from portal. will post OfferId when available.

sam: thanks everyone. will confirm webhook stub and partner note after portal returns OfferId.
